title: Why people say they left their childhood religion
subtitle: U.S. adults raised in a religion who have left it, 2025
caption: Losing belief in the teachings tops the list, but plain drift comes close behind: "wasn't important" and "gradually drifted away" are each cited as often as church teaching or scandal. Share calling each an extremely or very important reason.
note: Leavers include people now in another religion and people now unaffiliated. Former Protestants answer much the same: stopped believing 45%, gradually drifted away 40%, not important in their life 38%. The colors are our grouping, not Pew's.
